purpose: W10-C: replace hard-coded/local privacy portal claims with durable data-processing, data-subject request, retention/legal-hold and processor/subprocessor governance that reports only evidenced platform behavior and preserves legal/business records according to policy.
authorization: Owner instruction on 2026-09-05 to continue PC-CROP. Staged only; no implementation authority before separate governance review/merge and immutable base-state promotion.
requiredInvariants: Privacy UI and APIs report only server-evidenced processing/storage/processor facts. Static local text cannot assert that a right, deletion, export, consent, processor or retention control has been executed.

ProcessingPurpose/LegalBasis/DataCategory/Recipient/Processor records are versioned and source-linked. A processor/subprocessor is not listed as active unless an approved integration/provider/contract evidence path supports that claim.

DataSubjectRequest is a durable lifecycle for access, export, correction, restriction/objection and deletion where legally applicable, with requester identity proof, scope, deadlines, review, execution evidence and completion receipt.

A deletion request never physically deletes records that a pinned legal/contract/audit/financial/regulatory retention policy requires to be retained. Those records enter explicit retained/legal-hold/not-applicable result with reason/evidence.

RetentionPolicy is versioned by data class/object type, legal/business basis, duration/start event, archive/delete/anonymize action and legal-hold override. Historical objects pin the policy/revision applied.

LegalHold is explicit, scoped, reason/evidence bound, effective-dated and authorized; it prevents retention deletion/anonymization for matching records without rewriting the original retention schedule.
Exports are generated from current authorized subject-linked data under minimization policy and return an immutable export manifest/hash; creation/queueing is not proof the subject downloaded it.

Corrections create new canonical domain versions through the owning domain authority where correction is legally/technically allowed; privacy governance cannot directly rewrite Deal/document/ledger/audit facts.

Consent, where used, is separate from other legal bases and has versioned notice/content, grant/withdrawal evidence and scope. Withdrawal does not retroactively invalidate processing performed under another valid basis.
Current user/organization/staff authority and recent MFA for high-risk export/deletion operations are revalidated before mutation and replay; cross-tenant/subject access is denied.
Every privacy-governance mutation commits immutable event, audit, outbox and receipt atomically with idempotency/CAS.
No privacy action weakens security logging, immutable audit, financial/legal evidence, Role Eligibility or external regulatory obligations.
Registration, Role Eligibility, Federal Accounting lock #4321, domain authorities, external contracts and REG.RU production topology remain unchanged.
acceptance: Static regression proves the privacy portal no longer presents local hard-coded completion/processor/retention claims as server truth.
Restricted PostgreSQL tests prove DSR lifecycle, subject/tenant isolation, identity/authority checks, deadlines, idempotency and immutable completion evidence.
Deletion/retention tests prove records under legal/audit/financial/regulatory hold are not deleted and return exact retained/not-applicable reasons.
Retention/legal-hold tests reproduce actions from exact policy versions and preserve old schedules when policies change.
Processor registry cannot mark an external provider active without accepted provider/integration/contract evidence reference.
Export tests produce a content manifest/hash and deny cross-subject/cross-tenant/revoked actor/MFA-stale attempts.
Audit/outbox/event failure rolls back the governance command and no completed DSR/hold/retention action remains without evidence.
Exact-head CI/review plus legal/privacy review and REG.RU real-user request evidence remain required before terminal privacy credit.
remainingTerminalBoundary: Final legal bases/retention periods/processor list require jurisdiction- and company-specific legal approval and actual provider contracts.
Domain-specific correction/deletion adapters require separate accepted changes to each owning authority where applicable.
Settings W8-C can expose preferences/privacy controls only after this authority exists.
Human privacy/legal acceptance and incident/request operational drills remain mandatory.
